hints.title: Win Condition per Player
hints.text: Player i wins if they possess strictly more than i balls of any single color, meaning max count for player i exceeds i.

hints.title: Frequency Matrix
hints.text: Maintain color frequencies per player using a table with dimensions n by eleven.

hints.title: Player Iteration
hints.text: For each player, check if any color frequency strictly exceeds the player index. If so, increment winner count and proceed to next player.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Color set size is bounded by 10.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeatedly searching the pick array per player yields O(n * m) runtime.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n * 10) space stores full frequency matrix.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Groups picks by player and evaluates victory condition per player.
